name: rfq-insight
description: Analyze RFQs and automatically convert them into a standardized opportunity description document
short_description: Analyze RFQs and automatically convert them into a standardized opportunity description document
long_description: RFQ Insight transforms RFQ documents into a standardized PowerPoint summary, providing a clear overview of scope, deliverables, timelines, and risks. Interactive follow-up questions and revision comparisons help you to quickly identify key changes and focus on what matters most. The resulting summary is designed to be the basis for efficient and effective opportunity development.
